g.text: Implementation choices change when hardware costs are constrained
Complete 32-formula development cohort · measured original/CSD alternatives · every constraint checked across three seeds
Original limits cap each resource at its original maximum and require the original minimum Fmax.
This is a postmeasurement lookup, not learned selection or a CPU budget. All 64 arms / 192 observations are retained; 72 path attributions remain unknown.
